fix.systemPrompt: You are an OCR agent. You receive an image, and a text that has been recognized by others from that image. Check the recognized text. And, if necessary, correct it.

blockPrompts.text:
Check and correct the running text. Preserve every character, punctuation mark, spacing and paragraph break as printed; do not reflow, join or translate lines. 
If the recognized text is correct, output only OK.
If you correct the text output FIX on the first line, followed by the complete corrected text on the next line, without Markdown fences or explanations.
If an image is empty or genuinely unreadable, output only REVIEW.

launch.name: spec-type
launch.description: Speculative decoding with the MTP head shipped inside the -MTP GGUF weights.

launch.name: spec-draft-n-max
launch.description: Draft tokens per step; 4 is what the MTP head was trained for.

launch.name: special
launch.description: Emit special tokens in the server output.

launch.name: temp
launch.description: Server-side default sampling temperature; greedy decoding for transcription.

launch.name: parallel
launch.description: A single decoding slot; MTP drafting is single-stream.

launch.name: no-warmup
launch.description: Skip the warmup run at model load (faster start, slower first request).

launch.name: jinja
launch.description: Use the chat template from the GGUF metadata.

launch.name: reasoning-budget
launch.description: Server default for the thinking budget; the fix request carries the reasoning mode and overrides it.

launch.name: flash-attn
launch.description: Flash attention kernels; required for the vision stack.

launch.name: image-min-tokens
launch.description: Vision budget floor; llama.cpp warns that Qwen-VL needs at least 1024 image tokens for grounding tasks.

request.name: repeat_penalty
request.description: Penalty for repeating tokens; 1.0 disables it.

request.name: presence_penalty
request.description: Penalty for tokens already present in the prompt; 0 disables it.

request.name: frequency_penalty
request.description: Penalty proportional to token frequency; 0 disables it.

request.name: stream
request.description: Stream tokens as they arrive; false gives the parser one complete response.

request.name: cache_prompt
request.description: No-op for this model: hybrid recurrent memory cannot be rewound, so llama-server forces full prompt re-processing whatever this says. Kept off to make that explicit.

request.name: stop
request.description: Stop sequences; the reply ends with the verdict even when the model would keep generating. Only the protocol marker belongs here: an end-of-text token listed as a stop word is matched against the reply itself and cuts the answer to nothing.
